sections.heading: What is trending: “dados”

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Tue, 11 Aug 2026 04:30:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-08-11T11:57:16+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-08-11T11:57:50+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.

faq.a: Google's Trending Now feed links the spike to coverage from Dinheiro Vivo, Jornal de Negócios, SAPO. The associated headlines are: “Capacidade de data centers em Portugal sobe 23% e posiciona o país no top‑10 mundial” (Dinheiro Vivo); “Vila Franca de Xira ganha peso no mapa europeu dos centros de dados com projeto que pode chegar aos 300 MW” (SAPO); “Portugal entre os mercados europeus mais competitivos para centros de dados, revela estudo” (Jornal de Negócios).
Google reports at least 100 searches in PT as of the feed snapshot. This is a published lower bound, not an exact count.
This snapshot covers PT. The same term may trend differently in other regions.
